subject: general
question: Among the four words listed below, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic here is-

 
• Fear, happiness and anger are different types of emotions or feelings that are expressed by an individual.
 
• Whereas, intelligence is an ability of an individual to acquire and apply knowledge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6859d866420de34623a5c31b9dd5452a64b0c82a2c8e31e11eb555a52fc96eb0.png] 

Hence, **'option 4' ** is the correct answer.
